sentence_stem: Although the new law was approved in March,
correct_completion: many workers still do not know its rules.
full_sentence: Although the new law was approved in March, many workers still do not know its rules.
acceptable_variants: few people have read the text yet.
the government has not started enforcing it.

options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result. The idea of perfect understanding does not contrast with the approval of the law, as 'although' requires.
'Because' introduces a cause, not a contrast. The clause after 'although' must show something unexpected.

options.text: many workers still do not know its rules.
it was approved by the parliament.
options.why_wrong: This repeats passive information already given in the stem instead of creating a contrast.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' and passive voice in the first clause
explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first part. Here, the law was approved, but workers still lack knowledge of it. Learners often add a result clause with 'so', which breaks the contrast.
translation: Embora a nova lei tenha sido aprovada em março, muitos trabalhadores ainda não conhecem suas regras.
